newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers sets 2 mln shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers sets 2 mln shr buyback.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Thursday that board had authorized the repurchase of up to two million shares, or about seven percent of the total outstanding.
The company said the repurchases are in addition to the three million share buyback announced in May 1996.

Chairman and Chief Executive Bob Simpson said, "We believe that stock purchases at current prices represent an excellent value and, when coupled with the purchase of strategic producing properties, will continue to achieve our 25 percent to 30 percent historical growth in value per share."
